thread:
Maya: Heads-up — after last night's traffic replay we saw a p99 latency regression on the model serving fleet (~+20% vs baseline). Can we run a focused ramp + heap/CPU profiling this afternoon to isolate whether it's a runtime regression or traffic pattern change? Need capacity check and someone to own profiling captures. @Alex @Liam

Alex: I can own the k6 job and deployment side. Which infra do you want me to target — `perf-1` or `staging-2`?

Maya: Prefer perf-1 (same kernel/driver as prod). I'll provision 3 extra model nodes and lift quotas. Plan: small ramp (15m) to 500 rps using the replay trace, capture k6 JSON + flamegraphs.

Maya: k6 command we should run:
```
k6 run --vus 500 --duration 15m --out json=./k6-output.json \ 
  --env REPLAY_TRACE=s3://redwood-replays/2026-03-16/replay.json \ 
  --script ./scripts/replay.js
```

Liam: I'll handle perf captures on the model server nodes. Proposal: start `perf record -a -g -F 99 -o perf.data` at t=0, sample heap with `gperftools`/`pprof` every 5m and take a `gcore` if RSS climbs > 80%. Do we want KV cache debug on?

Sara: I'll wire up live dashboards and alerts. Adding p95/p99 latency, CPU, GC pause, RSS, and kv_cache_hit_rate panels. I'll also add a temporary alert to page `#eng-oncall` if p99 > 1.5s or RSS increases > 15% within 10m.

Alex: Starting k6 job on perf-1 cluster now. Link: https://perf.k6/jobs/1769001234 (running). ETA ~18m. I'll post the job output when done.

perf-bot: Artifacts uploader: k6 JSON and initial flamegraphs will be uploaded to s3://redwood-perf/artifacts/1769001234/ — will post links when available.

Maya: Quick ops checklist before we ramp: 1) Ensure one read-only replica for telemetry out-of-band; 2) Enable PROFILING env var on model servers; 3) Set `MAX_BATCH_TOKENS=4096` to match baseline. If memory growth observed, abort and snapshot logs. :warning:

Liam: Got it. I'll enable `PROFILING=true` and start `perf`. If we see GC churn, I'll capture heapdumps at the 10m mark with `gcore $(pidof model_server)`.

Sara: Dashboards are ready and I'll keep an eye during the run. Added a temporary dashboard link: https://console.redwood/d/rt/perf-1769001234

Alex: k6 finished. Summary: 15m run, peak 520 rps, avg latency +18% p99. Uploaded k6-output.json. Link: s3://redwood-perf/artifacts/1769001234/k6-output.json

perf-bot: Upload complete — flamegraphs: https://s3.console.aws/fg/1769001234/flame.svg, perf.data: s3://redwood-perf/artifacts/1769001234/perf.data

Liam: Initial look: CPU hotspots in attention kernel and a surprising amount in malloc/free (libstdc++). Heap snapshot shows a small steady growth in a cache bucket — suspect GC threshold tuning. I'll post pprof flamegraph shortly.

Maya: Great work — can we meet for a 30m runbook sync at 17:00 to decide rollback vs tuning? Drop a +1 if you can attend.

Alex: +1

Liam: +1

Sara: +1 — I'll bring dashboard screenshots and alert timelines.

deploy-bot: Note: no deploys allowed to perf-1 until post-mortem complete (lock applied by Maya).
